lab_questions.title: Parking Capacity & Slot Availability Management
lab_questions.description: Debug and fix 3 critical parking capacity and availability management bugs in a Django REST Framework API. Accurately calculate available slots by excluding disabled, reserved, and occupied slots without double-counting, reject new vehicle allocations when the parking lot reaches maximum capacity under serial and concurrent requests, and ensure slot availability updates immediately after vehicle checkout.
lab_questions.startup_command: python manage.py migrate && python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8010

tasks.title: Calculate Available Slots Correctly
tasks.description:
The availability endpoint `GET /api/parking/availability/` uses a naive calculation (`total_slots - occupied_slots`) that misreports parking capacity by treating disabled and reserved slots as available.

**Testing in Swagger UI:**
1. Open preview to view the Swagger UI.
2. Submit `GET /api/parking/availability/` on a parking lot with disabled (`is_active=False`) or reserved (`is_reserved=True`) slots.
3. Observe that disabled and reserved slots are counted in `available_slots`.

**Goal:** Fix the availability calculation in `parking/views.py` so that only active (`is_active=True`), non-reserved (`is_reserved=False`), and unoccupied slots without an active session (`status="ACTIVE"`) are counted as available, avoiding double-counting.

tasks.title: Reject Entry When the Lot Is Full
tasks.description:
The allocation endpoint `POST /api/parking/allocate/` allows new vehicles to enter and be assigned slots even when no eligible vacant slots remain in the facility.

**Testing in Swagger UI:**
1. Open preview to view the Swagger UI.
2. Allocate all available eligible slots using `POST /api/parking/allocate/`.
3. Submit an additional allocation request once all slots are occupied.
4. Observe that the API accepts the entry with `201 Created` instead of rejecting it.

**Goal:** Ensure allocation requests are rejected with **HTTP 400 Bad Request** or **HTTP 409 Conflict** when the lot is full or the requested slot is ineligible, and protect against concurrent over-allocation using database transactions and row-level locks.

tasks.title: Update Availability After Checkout
tasks.description:
The checkout endpoint `POST /api/parking/checkout/` fails to mark the parking session as completed, causing vacated slots to remain occupied in availability queries.

**Testing in Swagger UI:**
1. Open preview to view the Swagger UI.
2. Allocate a slot and verify the availability count decreases.
3. Checkout the slot via `POST /api/parking/checkout/`.
4. Call `GET /api/parking/availability/` and observe that available slots does not increase.
5. Observe that repeated checkout requests on the same session are not rejected.

**Goal:** Update `CheckoutSlotView` in `parking/views.py` to set `session.status = ParkingSession.STATUS_COMPLETED`, update `exit_time`, immediately release the slot in availability, and reject repeated checkouts with **HTTP 400 Bad Request**.
